paras: Tropidonophis dahlii, also known commonly as the New Britain keelback, is a species of snake in the subfamily Natricinae of the family Colubridae. The species is native to Indonesia and Papua New Guinea.
The specific name, dahlii, is in honor of German zoologist Karl Theodor Friedrich Dahl.
The preferred natural habitat of Tropidonophis dahlii is forest near streams, at altitudes of 760–1,070 m (2,490–3,510 ft).
